itemListElement.name: Products
itemListElement.description: Practical resources that help you choose a business problem, take action, and build momentum.

itemOffered.name: Your Free Business Strategy Report
itemOffered.description: Choose your priority. Answer ten questions. Get clear findings and a 30–60–90-day roadmap. Find a practical next step for getting more leads, improving lead quality, closing deals, saving time, increasing repeat business, or improving profitability. Your personalized AI-generated report includes key findings and a focused 90-day plan, delivered by email and available to download. Bring it to an optional free Strategy Review.

itemListElement.name: Services
itemListElement.description: Expert guidance and practical implementation to identify valuable opportunities, put your business knowledge to work, and help your people use AI with confidence.

itemOffered.name: 1 on 1 Team Member Training
itemOffered.description: Help each employee apply AI to their actual responsibilities with practical skills, confidence, and clear review habits. Training focuses on the tasks the person performs, the standards their work must meet, and the tools they can use. We practice relevant examples, develop reusable approaches, and show how to check results before relying on them. The employee leaves with techniques they can apply in their role and a clearer understanding of when human judgment is needed.

image.description: 1 on 1 Team Member Training. Help each employee apply AI to their actual responsibilities with practical skills, confidence, and clear review habits.

itemOffered.name: AI Strategy Session
itemOffered.description: Get focused guidance on where AI, automation, or better ways of working could create meaningful value. Bring a business goal and the challenge getting in its way. In one hour, we explore the priority problem, consider a practical opportunity, and identify what needs to be understood before you commit further resources. You receive an AI Opportunity Summary with the desired outcome, an initial success measure, and recommended next steps. Those steps may involve coaching, training, a coordinated workflow, or deeper assessment through the SUSO Framework.

image.description: AI Strategy Session. Get focused guidance on where AI, automation, or better ways of working could create meaningful value.

itemOffered.name: Business Context Integration and Prompt Systems
itemOffered.description: Connect existing information with practical AI systems and tested prompts to reduce research, repeated explanations, and rework. Your business already holds valuable context in documents, meeting notes, customer records, procedures, and everyday decisions. We identify the sources that matter to a selected workflow, organize the relevant information, and integrate it into a practical system your team can use. We build reusable prompts and instructions around your standards, customers, and goals, then test them against real tasks such as preparing proposals, responding to clients, onboarding employees, or producing reports. Within the agreed scope, you receive a source and context map, a working context-supported workflow, a tested prompt library, and guidance for reviewing outputs and keeping information current. The focus is making your existing knowledge useful at the moment work happens, with clear ownership of updates and appropriate access to source material.

itemOffered.name: Group Trainings and Workshops
itemOffered.description: Give teams practical experience using AI together on problems that matter to the business. Workshops bring people around relevant use cases, shared expectations, and hands-on practice. We help the team identify useful applications, compare approaches, and develop clearer habits for using and reviewing AI-assisted work. Participants leave with practical examples and agreed next steps they can bring into their roles. Focused individual training can support team members who need more help afterward.

itemOffered.name: Ongoing AI and Operational Systems Advisory
itemOffered.description: You want a continuing partner to review results and guide the next operating improvements. Periodic reviews examine workflow performance, business outcomes, new constraints, technology decisions, and roadmap priorities. We consider whether existing systems need refinement and where new capabilities are justified. This is strategic guidance around operating capacity and business value. The cadence, responsibilities, and any implementation work are agreed for the engagement.

itemOffered.name: Operational Workflow and Agentic Systems Architecture
itemOffered.description: You understand the problem and need a coherent design for how the improved workflow should operate. We map the future workflow and define its trigger, objective, inputs, steps, decisions, systems, handoffs, exceptions, and completion criteria. We specify what stays with people, what follows fixed automation rules, and where AI or an agent may be useful. The design addresses information access, permitted actions, approvals, escalation routes, integration requirements, ownership, and measurement. It gives your team and implementation partners a shared basis for building and testing. This offer develops the workflow and system design. Existing Agentic Orchestration Enablement remains available for enabling coordinated agents and workflows.

itemOffered.name: Personal Executive AI Coaching
itemOffered.description: Use AI in your own working day to improve preparation, communication, prioritization, and decision support. Coaching starts with the work competing for your attention: planning, research, meetings, communication, and follow-through. We develop practical ways to use AI around your responsibilities and refine them through use. You build repeatable habits for preparing information, reviewing outputs, and applying your judgment. The focus is more usable leadership capacity and greater confidence guiding AI adoption across the business.

image.description: Personal Executive AI Coaching. Use AI in your own working day to improve preparation, communication, prioritization, and decision support.

itemOffered.name: Profitable Growth and AI Opportunity Assessment
itemOffered.description: You know the business needs to operate differently, but you are unsure what to fix first or where AI belongs. We examine your goals, workflows, systems, information flows, bottlenecks, and current measures. We compare opportunities by potential value, readiness, feasibility, cost, and risk. Within the agreed scope, the assessment produces a current-state view, constraint analysis, prioritized opportunities, business-value hypotheses, an AI and agentic suitability assessment, a recommended roadmap, and success measures. You leave with a clearer investment decision and an evidence-based direction for deeper design. Any business-value estimates remain hypotheses until validated against your operating data. This is a scoped consulting assessment. It is separate from the free self-service Business Strategy Report and from the current SUSO Framework package, which retains its existing prototype commitment.

I work across leadership, operational teams, developers, vendors, and specialists to clarify requirements and guide implementation decisions. The scope can include a phased roadmap, partner coordination, prototype reviews, acceptance criteria, implementation reviews, and outcome validation. The value is continuity of judgment from the original business problem through implementation and adoption. Responsibilities, build scope, and acceptance criteria are agreed before delivery work begins.

itemOffered.name: SUSO Framework
itemOffered.description: Turn a priority opportunity into a business case, solution architecture, and a Phase 1 or MVP prototype. Our Value Mapping and Solution Architecture process connects your goals to the people, workflows, and information that shape results. We establish a baseline, identify opportunities, and prioritize them by value, cost, effort, and feasibility. Within the agreed scope, you receive a value map, phased plan, solution architecture, and a working Phase 1 or minimum viable product prototype, with testing and handoff guidance. Depending on complexity, we may also publish a live version if testing and client acceptance can be completed within the agreed timeframe.

itemListElement.name: Solutions
itemListElement.description: Connected capabilities that help your business win work, improve operations, protect information, turn knowledge into reusable assets, and make better decisions.

itemOffered.name: Agentic Orchestration Enablement
itemOffered.description: Coordinate AI agents and workflows to reduce manual handoffs while keeping responsibilities and approvals clear. When a process spans several tools or teams, useful work can stall between steps. We help design and enable coordinated agents and workflows with defined tasks, connections, human approval points, and monitoring. Start with a bounded use case and build on what testing shows. The result is a clearer path for information and work to move, with people retaining control over the decisions assigned to them.

image.name: Connected email, spreadsheet, and cloud tasks passing through human approval into a results dashboard.
image.caption: Connected email, spreadsheet, and cloud tasks passing through human approval into a results dashboard.
image.description: Agentic Orchestration Enablement. Coordinate AI agents and workflows to reduce manual handoffs while keeping responsibilities and approvals clear.

itemOffered.name: Agentic Workflow Pilot
itemOffered.description: A promising workflow needs practical evidence before a larger commitment. We select one bounded use case, establish a baseline, and test a controlled version with defined information sources, permissions, human review, exception handling, and success measures. Possible starting points include service-request coordination, information retrieval, customer-update preparation, service-report processing, follow-up management, and exception identification. The right choice depends on your workflow and readiness. The pilot tests usefulness, reliability, review effort, adoption, and business value. Its results inform whether to improve, expand, or stop. This pilot tests one agreed use case. It complements existing Agentic Orchestration Enablement and does not replace the Phase 1 or MVP included in an agreed SUSO Framework package.

image.description: Agentic Workflow Pilot. A promising workflow needs practical evidence before a larger commitment.

itemOffered.name: AI and Data Governance
itemOffered.description: Define who owns decisions, how information should be used, and where review or approval is needed. Teams can move forward more confidently when expectations are clear. We help establish practical ownership, approved uses, review responsibilities, and escalation paths for AI and data. The work is shaped around your business and the way people actually operate. Clear guidance supports consistent adoption, while training and security controls help put that guidance into practice.

image.description: AI and Data Governance. Define who owns decisions, how information should be used, and where review or approval is needed.

itemOffered.name: AI Business Brains and Marketplace Knowledge Products
itemOffered.description: Build a reusable AI brain that helps your team apply company knowledge, or package your expertise into a knowledge product designed for marketplace sales. Your experience, methods, and business knowledge can become an asset people use repeatedly. Building on our work with Mygentic, we help turn approved source material into a focused AI brain with a clear audience, useful capabilities, and a practical plan for testing and ongoing improvement. Internal Business Brain Give employees a consistent way to find and apply your processes, service standards, product knowledge, training, and lessons learned. We organize the knowledge around real questions and tasks, define how the brain should respond, and test its usefulness with the people who will use it. The aim is faster onboarding, fewer repeated questions, more consistent work, and less dependence on one person holding all the answers. Marketplace Knowledge Product Turn expertise you own or are authorized to commercialize into a focused brain for a defined buyer and business problem. We help shape the offer, organize the knowledge, develop useful prompts and guided experiences, test representative tasks, and prepare product descriptions, demonstrations, and onboarding materials. Marketplace preparation includes planning access, support, and updates. Publication follows the selected platform’s requirements and your approval. Private company and client information stays separate from the material intended for sale. Within the agreed scope, the work includes an audience and use-case brief, a knowledge map, a working brain prototype, testing criteria, and an ownership and update plan. The internal path focuses on business adoption. The marketplace path also considers buyer demand, delivery costs, and the effort required to support customers.

itemOffered.name: Business Analytics
itemOffered.description: Create meaningful measures, dashboards, and reports that show what is happening and where to improve. Reporting is most useful when it answers a decision-maker’s question. We define the measures that matter, connect the relevant information, and create views people can use to monitor performance. Focus areas may include customer response, service delivery, quality, workload, and process bottlenecks. Clear definitions and review habits help the business act on what it learns. Margin-focused questions can be developed through Profitability Analytics.

itemOffered.name: CRM Integration
itemOffered.description: Connect customer information and sales activity so your team can see each opportunity and its next step. When contacts, inquiries, and follow-up live in different places, opportunities can lose momentum. We connect the customer-facing workflows around lead capture, records, ownership, and sales progression. The scope may include website inquiries, reminders, handoffs, and visibility into the pipeline. Your team gains a more consistent way to manage relationships and act on the information it already has.

itemOffered.name: Custom Integration
itemOffered.description: Help information move between applications so people spend less time copying, checking, and chasing it. We connect business systems around the information and events a workflow needs. This can include transferring records, coordinating updates, and handling exceptions across applications. The work starts with the purpose of the connection and defines what should move, when, and who owns problems. It supports broader operations as well as coordinated AI workflows, with customer-specific sales processes addressed through CRM Integration.

itemOffered.name: Data Architecture
itemOffered.description: Organize and connect business information so it is easier to find, understand, and use. Scattered or inconsistent information makes reporting, automation, and AI harder to trust. We help define the structure, sources, relationships, and movement of the data your business needs. The work connects information requirements to real use cases and supports a practical path toward more reliable data. Ownership, access, and reporting needs are considered alongside the technical design.

itemOffered.name: Profitability Analytics
itemOffered.description: Connect revenue, costs, and delivery effort to make better decisions about clients, services, and capacity. Revenue tells only part of the story behind business performance. We bring relevant financial and operating information together to examine profitability by client, service, project, or workflow. Agreeing on definitions and data sources helps make the resulting views useful for decisions. You can better see where delivery effort, rework, or resource use affects margins and where improvement deserves attention.

itemOffered.name: Security
itemOffered.description: Strengthen practical controls around data, AI tools, and connected systems as your capabilities develop. Connecting tools and introducing AI changes how information moves and who can access it. We help identify the controls needed for the agreed use case, including access permissions, data handling, and system connections. The work is coordinated with your existing policies and responsible specialists where needed. Clear controls and review responsibilities support more confident implementation and day-to-day use.
